description: A shell script for managing external toolchain tasks, including testing compiler features, finding libraries and binaries, creating wrapper scripts, and generating configuration files for cross-compilation environments.

methods.name: test_c
methods.description: Tests C compiler support by compiling a simple program.

methods.name: test_cxx
methods.description: Tests C++ compiler support by compiling a simple program.

methods.name: test_softfloat
methods.description: Tests soft-float support in the compiler.

methods.name: test_uclibc
methods.description: Checks if uClibc is used by inspecting sysroot libraries.

methods.name: test_feature
methods.description: Performs feature detection for compiler and libc features.

methods.name: find_libs
methods.description: Finds shared libraries matching specified patterns.

methods.name: find_bins
methods.description: Finds binary executables matching specified patterns.

methods.name: wrap_bin_cc
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script for the C compiler.

methods.name: wrap_bin_ld
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script for the linker.

methods.name: wrap_bin_other
methods.description: Creates a generic wrapper script for other binaries.

methods.name: print_config
methods.description: Generates a .config file for a specified target based on detected features.
